claims.title: What the Charter actually allocates
claims.statement: Board decisions require the chair's approval; Executive Board decisions can be vetoed by the chair. Budget and disbursement oversight is assigned to the Executive Board.
claims.scope: Article 2.2 also retains member-state consent for territorial jurisdiction and participation. These provisions do not establish personal control over every Gaza transaction.

claims.title: Authority, trusteeship and money paid
claims.statement: The Board's May report describes reconstruction-finance arrangements involving the GRAD fund, NCAG and the World Bank; July World Bank remarks discuss the financing architecture.
claims.scope: Read the Board report as self-report. Trusteeship, strategic direction, funding pledged, money received and actual disbursement require separate records.

claims.title: Do the institutional dates equal forty-two months?
claims.statement: The Council's authorization runs through December 31, 2027, subject to further action. The Charter uses three-year membership terms and separate renewal/dissolution rules.
claims.scope: None of these is itself the forty-two-month interval in Revelation 13. A proposed prophetic clock needs a separately justified starting criterion.

claims.title: Three different payment subjects
claims.statement: FT reported early exploration of a dollar-pegged Gaza stablecoin in February 2026. A 2020 academic Gaza Wallet/Gaza Coin design is a different item.
claims.scope: The older Wiki chat cannot establish prior knowledge of the later Board proposal. No official launch, universal use requirement or personal-loyalty condition was verified.

claims.title: Digital payments can also widen access
claims.statement: UNCDF describes PalPay adoption and a PMA rule letting Gaza merchants register with a national ID instead of unavailable business-registration documents.
claims.scope: This is a reported reduction of barriers, not proof of a Trump-controlled cryptocurrency or ideological test. Distinguish authorization for access from exclusion by political allegiance.

claims.title: Cities, AI income and approval are separate claims
claims.statement: The March 2023 Freedom Cities transcript proposes a competition for up to ten cities on US federal land.
claims.scope: The consulted proposal does not establish a Gaza scheme, AI-generated resident income, a designated currency, or political approval as an eligibility condition. The combined scenario remains the user's speculative research question.

claims.title: Published prophetic interpretations exist
claims.statement: River Wilde's February 2026 post connects the Board to Daniel's covenant. A January video listing explicitly combines First Beast language and the Board.
claims.scope: These establish dated interpretations, not their truth or a consensus among scholars. The blog text was read; the video entry was inspected only as metadata.

claims.title: Humanitarian conditions and theological interpretation
claims.statement: This follow-up records conditions and forecast windows, not a measured Tribulation index. It keeps the user's forty-two-month comparison as an attributed interpretation.
claims.scope: A humanitarian threshold does not locate the beginning of a prophetic period. Geographic breadth, duration, coercive eligibility and theological identification cannot silently substitute for one another.

claims.title: Existing sources are not complete developed investigations
claims.statement: At base commit f1d75d52303e6264b811c36d54e087156c9dae34, Board and Freedom Cities mentions were found in original conversations. The Gaza Coin source is an archived AI reply.
claims.scope: Exact indexed editorial searches returned no Board of Peace or Freedom Cities result. This bounds the audit; it does not certify that every synonym in every file was examined.

forecasts.title: Potential additional acute hunger by end-2027
forecasts.geography: Populations covered by WFP's El Nino analysis
forecasts.forecast: WFP says El Nino effects could push 49 million people into acute food insecurity by the end of 2027.
forecasts.assumptions_or_trigger: Retain the originating climate and livelihood assumptions; the public release does not reproduce the full model.
forecasts.verification: Recover the underlying geography, baseline and model; compare later consistent food-insecurity estimates and interventions.
forecasts.qualification_or_alternative: This is a risk projection, not a guaranteed additional count. Prevention and changed climate conditions can alter outcomes. Do not add it to other projections with overlapping populations.

forecasts.title: A defined winter-to-spring malnutrition window
forecasts.geography: Haiti; especially Cite Soleil and Cabaret
forecasts.forecast: The release projects Critical acute-malnutrition conditions in Cite Soleil and Cabaret for December 2026-May 2027. Its June 2026-May 2027 estimated child caseload is 253,725.
forecasts.assumptions_or_trigger: The full caseload period includes months before registration. Preserve the underlying IPC analysis and geographic units.
forecasts.verification: Compare later nutrition assessments, treatment access and the same full-period caseload definition.
forecasts.qualification_or_alternative: Caseload is not simultaneous prevalence. IPC Acute Malnutrition Phase 4 is not interchangeable with Acute Food Insecurity Phase 4 or a famine declaration.

forecasts.title: A forecast already extending through the harvest
forecasts.forecast: The June release expects Famine risk to persist in thirteen areas through the harvest period into January 2027.
forecasts.assumptions_or_trigger: Use the June vintage, with its conflict, access and livelihood assumptions; check for superseding IPC analyses.
forecasts.verification: Preserve the list of areas and compare subsequent area-specific IPC reports rather than national labels.
forecasts.qualification_or_alternative: Risk of Famine is not a claim that famine already exists in all those areas. Improved access or revised evidence can change the assessment.

forecasts.title: Near-term diesel tightness alongside later oil recovery
forecasts.geography: US distillates and global Brent market
forecasts.forecast: EIA projects US distillate inventories below 100 million barrels in October and below the 2021-2025 range through Q1 2027; its 2027 Brent average is $74 per barrel.
forecasts.assumptions_or_trigger: The baseline assumes production recovery and increasing trade flows; short-run distillate constraints and annual crude prices are different measures.
forecasts.verification: Use EIA weekly/monthly inventory series and the realized annual Brent mean; retain later revisions separately.
forecasts.qualification_or_alternative: The baseline contains recovery, not uninterrupted global collapse. Falling crude prices do not establish restored household food access everywhere.

forecasts.title: Winter services under continued infrastructure pressure
forecasts.forecast: If energy damage and access constraints persist into cold weather, heating, water and food-delivery needs can increase over the winter.
forecasts.assumptions_or_trigger: The UN winter plan identifies the exposure and plans to support 2.1 million people; that is a response target, not a predicted count without heat.
forecasts.verification: Track service interruption days, food delivery, aid reach, heating access and repair progress in fixed communities.
forecasts.qualification_or_alternative: Repairs, assistance and changed hostilities can prevent or reduce the projected service losses. National totals must not stand in for every locality.

forecasts.title: Winter and generator-dependent essential services
forecasts.geography: Gaza displacement sites and generator-dependent services
forecasts.forecast: If engine-oil, parts and shelter constraints persist through winter, water, sanitation, health and food-delivery services face further disruption.
forecasts.assumptions_or_trigger: OCHA records pending engine-oil approvals and constrained winter preparedness in its September 11 report. Approving authorities and service providers are not interchangeable actors.
forecasts.verification: Record oil entry and approvals, generator availability, water output, site flooding and clinic function against the same September baselines.
forecasts.qualification_or_alternative: Approvals, alternative power, repairs and relief can interrupt this pathway. A risk scenario is not a new area-level famine classification.

forecasts.title: Input exposure over the Boro cultivation window
forecasts.forecast: If fertilizer deliveries remain disrupted during the Boro window, farmers may reduce or delay inputs, affecting subsequent production or costs.
forecasts.assumptions_or_trigger: The World Bank's emergency program identifies import exposure and funds mitigation. Financing and actual delivery must be distinguished.
forecasts.verification: Compare fertilizer arrivals and use, planted area, relevant yields, weather and financed procurement milestones.
forecasts.qualification_or_alternative: Delivered inputs, substitution and favorable conditions can avoid the projected loss. This is not a forecast of inevitable famine in Bangladesh.

forecasts.title: Whether priority allocation expands, persists or ends
forecasts.kind: New institutional scenario; occurrence not asserted
forecasts.geography: Each individually documented Russian fuel-allocation jurisdiction
forecasts.forecast: If persistent shortages lead authorities to extend mandatory allocation, some purchases may depend on eligibility beyond possession of money.
forecasts.assumptions_or_trigger: The July priority-fuel report is the starting lead; obtain an actual order and baseline before claiming an extension.
forecasts.verification: Compare issuer, commodity, eligible group, denial rule, appeals, expiry and resumed ordinary sales.
forecasts.qualification_or_alternative: Optional commercial cards or open need-based allocation do not establish political allegiance tests. No universal card-only policy is inferred.

research_leads.title: A July 2026 commentary directly relevant to the Teacher comparison
research_leads.finding: Newsom and Schuller's The Thanksgiving Scroll distinguishes compositions about the Teacher. Chapters 8 and 15 address enemies, betrayal and divine protection through particular passages.
research_leads.use: Compare bounded passages and biblical intertexts before proposing identity. Shared scriptural templates, transmission and one-person identity are different explanations.

research_leads.title: A 2026 provenance project comparing Judean and Egyptian materials
research_leads.finding: SDU describes a combined material-analysis and handwriting project, including Egyptian papyri as comparative material.
research_leads.use: Track actual provenance results and uncertainty before connecting texts to a place, author or transmission route. Material origin would not by itself identify Jesus with the Teacher.

research_leads.title: New literary work on Exodus and transitions
research_leads.finding: Jiali Dang examines Exodus through rites of passage and liminal roles.
research_leads.use: This can develop the Wiki's treatment of narrative and authority; it does not supply an eruption date or archaeological proof of an Exodus chronology.

research_leads.title: Currency alternatives as a comparative control
research_leads.finding: The Atlantic Council study considers currency options for the Palestinian economy.
research_leads.use: Compare costs, governance, interoperability and dependence as analytic variables without treating any studied option as an adopted Board policy or endorsing it.

method: Separate original statements, enacted instruments, reported proposals, operational implementation and the author's theological comparisons. A source link establishes only the kind of relation it actually documents.

For the AI-income/Freedom-Cities scenario, require an identified income program, legal payer, source of real resources, currency, eligibility rule, exclusion authority and appeal route before calling the combined arrangement a documented plan.

The observable comparison concerns access to food, fuel, shelter, medical care and the consequences of refusal. Identification, humanitarian eligibility, security screening and political allegiance are different conditions; preserve the distinction in each case.
Do not combine different humanitarian scales, price series or populations into a single Tribulation score. Record individual variables, their dates and the persistence of a condition instead.

Forty-two calendar months is not automatically 1,260 days. A calendar convention and a proposed starting event are assumptions to disclose, not outputs of the humanitarian data. This edition sets no prophetic start or end date.

The five regions named by the user need separate civilian-harm, service, food-access and legal-authorization records. Ukraine and Gaza have explicit winter-service source leads here; the Russia row concerns allocation, while comparable Iran and Israel household baselines remain to be completed.

A link should state whether it documents a statement, reports implementation, supplies an alternative explanation, or motivates an analogy. Identical words in different archives are not independent witnesses.
These forecasts remain at their original issued dates. New thresholds and review criteria belong to this registration, not retrospectively to the institutions or to the user's earlier predictions.
The scheduled monthly review is a report to the user. It will propose additions for review but will not silently publish files, revise earlier claims or declare prophetic fulfillment.
